text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Maruzensky runs in the Radio Nikkei Sho during camp, and wins an outstanding victory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: When Maruzensky returns to camp, she is greeted by an ecstatic Special Week, who has watched the live broadcast of the race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Maruzensky is pleased to see that her participation in the race has had a positive effect on the younger athletes.
